answer.text: The manual gives minimum phone OS versions for the RE Mobile app, not a list of supported phone versions.
On Android, the app's minimum supported version is two versions behind the current Android OS.
On iOS, the minimum supported version is one version behind the current iOS release.

policy.text: The RE Mobile app's minimum supported Android version is two versions behind the current Android OS.
The RE Mobile app's minimum supported iOS version is one version behind the current iOS release.
